meta.purpose: Exact draw math for decisions and for validating core-engine::pot_odds (outs.rs was deleted in the 2026-11-10 decruft; this table is the survivor).
meta.provenance: card_printed values mirror the user's card screenshot-1.png ('Odds worth knowing'); the unseen47/unseen46/two_streets columns are the exact formula values 1-(1-o/47)(1-o/46). The card's rule of two and four is quoted below.
meta.columns: unseen47 = flop to turn (47 unseen); unseen46 = turn to river (46 unseen); two_streets = flop to river if seeing both.
meta.note: Rule of 2 and 4 tracks the card's rounding for 1-9 outs and drifts high above; use the exact columns for 12+.

implied_odds_guide.set_mining_22_66: need ~15-20x the open in effective stacks vs the raiser; more if callers behind may squeeze
implied_odds_guide.suited_connectors_call: implied from 2 pair+/straights/flushes; require 3%+ cold-call with position
implied_odds_guide.flush_draw_multiway: implied improves with 2+ callers; still respect the nut-only rule vs nits
implied_odds_guide.river_payoff_estimate: stations: add 25-50% implied to flop/turn calls; nits: discount 25%

spr_commitment.spr_3_to_6: two pair+ commits; one pair controls pot
spr_commitment.spr_ge_6: sets/straights+ only for stacks; everything else pot control
